metadata.scope: Both mechanisms on the Return entity: buyer self-service (VCST-5628), agent decisions and notifications (VCST-5883), legacy admin records. Orderless returns (VCST-5884) and the mandatory decline reason (VCST-5885) are out.
metadata.built_from: returns.md rev 1 (built), rev 2 (update 2026-10-06) (§1 value chain, §2, §3 D1-D9, §5), test model VCST-5883-2026-09-28 (Part 0, scenarios), suites 050o, 014c, 073, 073a, 073b (Title + References + status), run REG-2026-10-01-2133, kb entries below. No BL-RET / ECL returns oracle exists, so no oracle_refs.
